observations.dispute_text: PwC compares pay in job postings that ask for AI skills with postings that do not: a posting premium, not a measured effect of AI on wages.
observations.note: PwC 2026 Global AI Jobs Barometer press release (2025 data, 1bn+ job ads, 27 countries); pwc.com 403s bots, Wayback URL used. Confirms the brief's 62% (2025 edition was 56%).
observations.raw_snippet: Jobs requiring specific AI skills are growing almost eight times (69%) faster than the total jobs market (9%), with the average wage premium for AI skills rising to 62%
